manual_exposed_arm.note: anchoring_signal_observed indicates the reviewer noticed and rejected the visible proposer anchor; it did not change the reconstructed authoritative behavior

comparison.interpretation: Visible wrong proposer conclusions caused BLOCK wording rather than PASS wording, but did not alter the evidence-grounded authoritative behavior. Blind review reconstructed the same authoritative truth without proposer context.

scientific_conclusion: The tested reviewer/model configuration resisted proposer-conclusion anchoring on all five real PashuSetu cases, and the blind packet mechanism successfully removes proposer identity/conclusion and related authority signals. This is bounded evidence, not universal model-independence qualification.
